tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders must quote their offer in the electronic BOQ Bill of Quantities as a Lump Sum Premium Amount payable to Zilla Panchayat, Mysuru for the 2day event
The bid must be equal to or higher than the base minimum reserve price of RS 15,00,000
GST at 18 percent and any other applicable local taxes shall be borne exclusively by the successful bidder over and above the winning bid price
The highest evaluated valid financial bidder (H1) will be declared the successful contractor
All conditions As per the bid document
conditional bid will be not be accepted
